title: 《遗忘之海》首周运营总览：7 月 23 日移动端首发、gamescom demo、热修与资源查漏
titleEn: Sea of Remnants Week-One Live Ops: July 23 Mobile Launch, gamescom Demo, Hotfixes, and Resource Checks
summary: 把《遗忘之海》公测后一周到 7 月 23 日 10:00 移动端首发最值得优先处理的问题串起来：预下载/首发、gamescom demo、已知问题与热修、号角和大脸币收益、渡桥海查漏。
summaryEn: Routes the most important Sea of Remnants week-one issues into one hub: July 23 mobile launch, gamescom demo, known issues, hotfixes, Horn/Face Coin economy, and Bridge Sea cleanup.
content:
## 先给结论

到了 **2026 年 7 月 23 日 10:00**，《遗忘之海》已经进入新的强 intent 节点：移动端首发日；此前 **7 月 21 日 10:00** 的预下载已经把“安装包/空间/更新校验”推成首日高频问题。与此同时，gamescom 2026 demo 的外部曝光又把英文搜索推向 demo、gameplay、review、Steam、PS5/Xbox 和平台确认。

所以今天站点最该处理的不是再写一篇泛新手攻略，而是按问题直接选择下一页：

1. **我今天从 iOS / Android 入坑，先看哪个入口？**
2. **PC 和手机账号、区服、奖励怎么统一？**
3. **更新后卡死、流程卡点、热修变化先看哪里？**
4. **号角、大脸币、返航收益和渡桥海查漏怎么补？**
5. **gamescom demo 是不是意味着主机版日期确认？**

## 今天先看哪一页

| 你的问题 | 先看哪页 | 为什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 我是手机玩家，今天刚进服 | [移动端首发 FAQ](/zh/sea/guides/mobile-launch-guide) | 先解决入口、账号、区服、配置和首日路线 |
| 我不知道用 Steam、启动器还是手机 | [平台入口速查](/zh/sea/guides/platform-download-guide) | 把 PC、iOS、Android 和云试玩分开 |
| 我更新后出问题，或者热修后感觉不对 | [已知问题与热修追踪](/zh/sea/guides/known-issues-hotfix-guide) | 先分清客户端、流程还是版本问题 |
| 我最缺大脸币，不知道号角和返航怎么安排 | [号角、大脸币与返航收益指南](/zh/sea/guides/horn-farming-economy-guide) | 这是当前最直接的资源效率问题 |
| 我是海外搜索 / demo / review 关注度 | [PS5 / Xbox / Review / Gameplay FAQ](/zh/sea/guides/ps5-xbox-review-gameplay-faq) | 把 gamescom demo 和平台边界讲清楚 |

## 为什么 7 月 23 日要重排内容优先级

7 月 18 日以前，最强问题是“要不要等手机端”。今天以后，问题变成：

- 手机端正式入口在哪里，预下载后是否还要补更新；
- PC 和手机是不是同一账号和区服；
- 手机配置、发热和画质怎么保稳定；
- 首月资源、6 选 1、好金砖、号角、首发福利和 SSR/自选是否已经错过；
- gamescom demo 只是试玩曝光，还是平台日期确认。

这批问题比“什么是遗忘之海”更靠近转化，也更容易把新用户送进站点其他实用页。

## 首周问题继续保留

移动端首发不会让 PC 端首周问题消失，反而会让更多新用户撞上同样的问题：

- 更新后卡死或进页面异常；
- 7 月 16 日后部分路线体感变化；
- 大脸币和号角收益压力；
- 渡桥海篝火、遗迹、隐藏路线查漏；
- 隐秘海后续开放时间误读。

所以本页仍然要作为 live-ops 路由页维护，而不是一次性新闻。

  - https://www.taptap.cn/app/755604

- 站点相关页：移动端 FAQ、平台入口、热修追踪、号角收益、渡桥海查漏。
contentEn:
## Quick Answer

By **July 23, 2026 at 10:00**, Sea of Remnants has a new high-intent node: mobile launch day; the **July 21 10:00** pre-download window also pushed package, storage, and final-update checks into high-frequency support demand. At the same time, gamescom 2026 demo exposure is pushing English search demand toward demo, gameplay, review, Steam, PS5/Xbox, and platform-confirmation topics.

The site should not add another generic beginner guide first. It should route users by current problem:

1. I am starting today on iOS / Android.
2. I need account, server, and reward alignment between PC and mobile.
3. I hit crashes, hotfix changes, or route blocks.
4. I need Horn, Face Coin, return, and Bridge Sea cleanup advice.
5. I need to know whether gamescom demo confirms console timing.

## Which Page First?

| Your question | Best page | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mobile player starting today | [Mobile launch FAQ](/en/sea/guides/mobile-launch-guide) | Entry, account, server, specs, and first-day route |
| Steam, launcher, or phone? | [Platform entry guide](/en/sea/guides/platform-download-guide) | Separates PC, iOS, Android, and cloud trial |
| Update or hotfix broke something | [Known issues and hotfix tracker](/en/sea/guides/known-issues-hotfix-guide) | Classifies client, route, and version-side issues |
| Short on Face Coins | [Horn, Face Coin, and return guide](/en/sea/guides/horn-farming-economy-guide) | Current economy bottleneck |
| Demo / review / platform search | [PS5 / Xbox / Review / Gameplay FAQ](/en/sea/guides/ps5-xbox-review-gameplay-faq) | Explains gamescom demo and platform boundaries |

## Why July 23 Changes Priorities

Before July 23, the question was whether to wait for mobile. Now it is where the mobile entry is, whether pre-download still needs updates, how PC/mobile account and server work, how to keep phone performance stable, whether month-one rewards and SSR/selectors are still available, and whether gamescom demo should be read as a console-date signal.

These questions are closer to conversion than a generic “what is the game” page.

## Week-One Issues Still Matter

Mobile launch does not erase PC week-one problems. It brings more players into the same live-ops layer: crashes, July 16 hotfix feel changes, Horn and Face Coin pressure, Bridge Sea cleanup, and future Hidden Sea timing.

## Sources

- TapTap / channel and reservation pages: July 21, 2026 10:00 pre-download and July 23, 2026 10:00 mobile launch.
- Official/publisher gamescom 2026 demo exposure: useful for demo / review / gameplay / platform pages.
- Internal pages: mobile FAQ, platform entry, hotfix tracker, economy, and Bridge Sea cleanup.

faq.questionZh: 7 月 23 日以后这页还值得看吗？
faq.question: Is this page still useful after July 23?
faq.answerZh: 值得。它已经从“等手机端”变成“移动端首发 + 首周运营 + gamescom demo 指南”页面。
faq.answer: Yes. It has shifted from “wait for mobile” into a mobile-launch, week-one live-ops, and gamescom demo routing hub.

faq.questionZh: 手机端首发当天最该先做什么？
faq.question: What should mobile players do first on launch day?
faq.answerZh: 先确认官方入口、账号、区服和画质稳定性，再领取关键奖励和推进系统解锁，不要先乱花资源。
faq.answer: Confirm official entry, account, server, and stable graphics first. Then claim key rewards and unlock core systems before spending heavily.

faq.questionZh: gamescom demo 要不要单独做页？
faq.question: Should gamescom demo get a dedicated page?
faq.answerZh: 如果后续有 demo 内容、试玩反馈或平台信息细节，值得单独做；目前先放在 PS5/Xbox/Review/Gameplay FAQ 里更稳。
faq.answer: If demo content, hands-on feedback, or platform details grow, yes. For now, routing it into the PS5/Xbox/Review/Gameplay FAQ is safer.
